trigger_condition: Releasing peri_rst_n exactly two clock cycles before core_rst_n sets a sticky trigger bit.
payload_effect: The trigger forces protected_mode high and holds it high until both resets are asserted simultaneously again.
rationale: The design contains a reset-order-dependent sticky trigger logic. When peri_rst_n is released two cycles before core_rst_n, a counter detects the gap and sets trigger_set, which drives protected_mode high. This mode persists through normal operation and only clears when both resets are asserted simultaneously.
